    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Board
    Represents the core logic and state of a Tetris-like game board.
    Brick
    Represents a generic Tetris brick (tetromino).
    BrickGenerator
    Defines a generator for producing Tetris bricks.
    BrickMover
    Service class responsible for encapsulating all active brick manipulation logic (movement, rotation, and hold operations) by delegating to the Board implementation.
    BrickRotator
    Handles rotation logic for the game brick.
    ClearRow
    Represents the result of a row-clear operation.
    DownData
    Immutable data container representing the result of a downward brick move.
    EventSource
    Represents the origin of a game event.
    EventType
    Represents the types of game events triggered during play.
    GameController
    controller for managing game logic and coordinating between game board and UI Handles game events , score management and game state transactions * Timer management is delegated to GameTimerManager.
    GameOverPanel
    A panel displayed when the game ends.
    GameRenderer
    Responsible for all visual rendering operations in the Tetris game.
    GameTimerManager
    Manages all game timers including the level countdown timer and game loop timer.
    GhostPieceManager
    Manages the calculation and positioning logic for the ghost piece.
    GuiController
    GuiController handles all rendering, UI updates, keyboard input, game timeline control, and communication with the GameController.
    InputController
    Handles all keyboard input for the Tetris game.
    InputEventListener
    Listener interface for handling player input events in the game.
    LeaderboardController
    controller for the leaderboard screen.
    LeaderboardManager
    Manages leaderboard entries by saving scores to a text file, loading them back into memory, and sorting them in descending order.
    Main
    Entry point for the TetrisJFX application.
    MainMenuController
    controller for the main menu of the game.
    MatrixOperations
    Utility class providing matrix operations used by the Tetris game logic.
    MoveEvent
    Represents a game action request such as move, rotate, or drop.
    NextShapeInfo
    Encapsulates information about the next Tetris shape to be displayed.
    NotificationPanel
    A panel used to display temporary notifications (e.g., bonus points).
    RandomBrickGenerator
    Generates random Tetris bricks.
    SceneNavigator
    Responsible for switching scenes (main menu, leaderboard, game, etc.).
    SceneNavigator.GameSceneData
    Data class to hold scene and controller together.
    Score
    Manages the player's score and level progression in the game.
    ScoreEntry
    Represents a single entry in the leaderboard.
    SimpleBoard
    A simple implementation of the Game Board interface.
    SoundManager
    Utility class for managing background music playback.
    ViewData
    Represents the data required to render the current game view.
